arguments.text: Start done. Settle now, long smooth strokes, race rhythm.

6000 m, 6 legs of 1000 m out-and-back. Hard start drained about half the pod reserve by 200 m. Plan: settle to about critical power (pod 165-175 W) through the middle, keep pod reserve above about 25 pct until 1500 m to go, then spend it evenly; final sprint from about 400 m. Compare legs in the same direction; leg 1 had current against (push about -0.1 m/s). Watch for incidents (rudder weed, instrument drift, radio).

arguments.message: Pod reserve below 20 pct: ease toward critical power
GPS speed well below what pod power should give: possible weed on rudder or drag, or strong current

arguments.reason: Check the ease after the hard start took hold (pod power near 170 W?)

text: Cued ease to settle after a hard start that drained half the pod reserve; set plan, reserve and drag watches, wake in 2 min to check.

arguments.text: Ease a touch more, breathe, this is a long race.

3.0 min: pod reserve 17 pct, pod power 186 W vs CP 168. Cued ease with 171 s/500 ground target (current against about -0.08 on leg 1). Goal: pod about 160-168 W until reserve recovers above 25 pct. Leg 1 ground speed about 3.0 m/s.

arguments.reason: Check pod power settled near or just below CP after second ease

text: Cued ease with 171 s/500 target: pod reserve 17 pct and pod power still above CP; check in about 100 s.
no cue: ease cued 22 s ago, too early to judge; next check already set.

arguments.text: Good. Hold this effort through the turn, stay smooth.

4.7 min, 873 m: pod 178 W (CP 168), pod reserve 6.6 pct, boat reserve 15 pct. Paddler says 6/10, feeling good, could go harder. Evidence CP may be underestimated (test can be 10-25 pct off). Cued hold, not push. Test: if pod holds 175-180 W for 3+ more min with no forced drop or speed fade, raise pod CP to about 180 W (boat about 110 W).

arguments.message: Pod power fell well below CP: reserve empty (blow-up) or something wrong

arguments.reason: Judge whether CP is underestimated: pod power held near 178 W without fade?

text: Cued hold: model reserve nearly empty but paddler says 6/10 and could go harder, so testing whether CP is underestimated before pushing.

arguments.reason: Paddler said they are going harder; model pod reserve 5 pct. Check pod power when the next cue is allowed; if above about 195 W, ask to hold back until the last km.

text: no cue: gate closed for 54 s; paddler says they are pushing, will check pod power when a cue is allowed.
no cue: paddler did not surge (pod 174 W, just above CP), current now behind on leg 2; keep watching for a forced drop to test CP before changing anything.

arguments.reason: Pod model reserve read empty from about 6.5 min, yet the paddler held 172-188 W (mean 178) for 5 min with no forced drop and no speed fade at the same rate; test CP looks about 4 pct low. Effort rose 6 to 8 of 10, so not raised further.

arguments.text: 7.8 min, 1430 m: raised CP to pod 175 W / boat 108 W (from 168/104): held about 178 W for 5 min past model-empty with no fade. Paddler effort 6/10 at 4.7 min, 8/10 at 7.7 min, always says could go harder (overconfident?). Do not push yet; hold about 172-178 W. Leg 2 current behind (push_along +0.13), so ground pace flatters.

arguments.reason: Recheck pod power, fade and reserve after CP change

text: no cue: raised CP estimate to 175 W pod (reserve now reads 25 pct) because the paddler held 178 W past model-empty without fade; holding steady.

arguments.name: boat_share
arguments.description: Share of pod shaft power that reaches the boat (hull-model power / pod power); a drop means pod drift, a worse blade, or extra drag

arguments.message: Pod reserve under 8 pct (CP 175 W assumption)
Boat gets a smaller share of pod power than early race (0.62): pod drift, tired blade or drag

text: no cue: pod 182 W slightly above new CP while boat power is at CP and speed has not faded; added a watch on the share of pod power reaching the boat to catch pod drift or drag.

arguments.reason: Mid leg 3: compare with leg 1 via legs(); check pod power and share
Plan the spend of the reserve over the last 1500 m

text: no cue: just through the 2000 m turn, power dip is the turn; pacing near CP is right, checks set for mid leg 3 and 1600 m to go.

arguments.text: 11.6 min, 2130 m (leg 3, current against about -0.17): pod fell 183 to 139 W from the 2000 m turn (about 650 s). Paddler: 8/10, Just a breather, I am fine. Model reserve 25 pct (CP 175). Boat share rose 0.58 to 0.67 during the drop. Waiting about 40 s: if pod still under 150 W, cue push with ground pace about 177 s/500 (CP effort against this current).

arguments.reason: Has the paddler come back from the breather on their own? If pod still under 150 W, cue a return to CP effort

text: no cue yet: paddler calls the drop a breather and the model reserve is not empty; checking in 40 s whether they come back on their own.

arguments.text: Breather over. Build back to race power, smooth and steady.

12.3 min, 2260 m: still 138 W pod after 80 s of breather, same rate 57, speed fade -3.9 pct. Cued push to 178 s/500 ground (about CP against current -0.18). If pod does not rise above 160 W within 60-80 s, treat as a real blow-up: do not push again, reassure, let reserve rebuild, and lower CP back toward 170.

arguments.reason: Did the push cue bring pod power back to about 175 W, or is this a blow-up?

text: Cued push to 178 s/500: breather lasted 80 s with pod 138 W while model reserve is 35 pct; checking response in 75 s.

arguments.text: 13.7 min, 2480 m: push cue worked: pod back to 184 W, boat 113 W, ground 174 s/500 against current. The 2000 m slump was a voluntary breather, not a blow-up (responded to cue). Paddler takes breathers at turns? Watch the 3000 m turn.

text: no cue: push cue worked, pod back to 184 W with reserve rebuilt to about 40 pct; on plan.

arguments.text: Strong is good. Hold this, save the push for later.

text: Cued hold: paddler wants to go harder with 3.5 km left, already 189 W above the sustainable 179 W; reserve kept for the last 1500 m.

arguments.text: 14.1 min: legs: out leg 1 3.01 m/s at 187 W pod (push -0.06); back leg 2 3.15 at 180 W (+0.12); out leg 3 so far 2.75 at 153 W (-0.15, includes breather). Current appears to be growing (push_along -0.12 early, -0.18 now). Pod 193 W after the hold cue: if still above 188 W at next check, cue a small ease toward 180 W.

arguments.reason: Pod 193 W after hold cue; ease slightly if still above 188 W

text: no cue: hold cue 24 s old; legs show a growing current, nothing abnormal; check pod power in 60 s.

arguments.text: 15.3 min, 2750 m: POD LIKELY DRIFTING HIGH from about 840 s: pod rose 180 to 214 W in a smooth ramp while GPS speed stayed flat at 2.90 and boat-model power flat 110-114 W; share fell 0.61 to 0.53; paddler effort 7/10 (was 8). Not weed (speed did not drop). From now trust boat-model power (CP 108), boat reserve and GPS; ignore pod power, pod reserve and push_local.

6000 m, 6 legs of 1000 m out-and-back; current against on out legs (about -0.17), behind on back legs, growing. CP raised to boat 108 W (pod 175). Pod reading drifted high from about 14 min: pace on boat-model power (power_w) and boat reserve (reserve_left_pct), not pod. Middle: hold boat power about 108-114 W. From about 1500 m to go spend the boat reserve evenly (boat power about 120 W); final sprint from about 400 m. Paddler takes voluntary breathers (one at the 2000 m turn) and always says could go harder: a push cue brings them back, a hold cue keeps them from surging.

arguments.message: Boat-model power well below CP 108: breather, blow-up, weed or current change

arguments.reason: Just past the 3000 m turn: did the paddler take another breather? Judge by boat power and GPS, not pod

text: no cue: pod power is drifting high (speed and boat power flat, effort 7/10), so switched pacing and watches to boat-model power; boat power 114 W is on plan.

arguments.text: Clear the rudder: one quick back-stroke, then straight back on.

17.5 min, 3150 m: paddler says boat feels heavy, like something dragging (7/10). Rethink of 15.3 note: pod up with flat speed and flat boat power fits weed on the rudder (paddler working harder) as well as pod drift. Cued clear_rudder. Test: if boat_share returns toward 0.60 and GPS speed rises at same pod power, it was weed and the pod is fine again; if share stays about 0.53, pod drift.

arguments.reason: Check whether clearing the rudder restored speed and the pod-to-boat share

text: Cued clear_rudder: paddler reports drag and the boat gets a smaller share of pod power than early race; checking the result in 70 s.
no cue: rudder-clear cue only 10 s old; the speed dip is expected from the back-stroke; checking at the next wake-up.

arguments.text: 18.8 min, 3370 m: clear_rudder done at 17.5 min (back-stroke seen, 36 pct dip). GPS speed on leg 4 (back) plateaued 3.02 before the clear, 3.11-3.13 and rising after, pod unchanged about 211 W: some drag was probably removed. Share still only 0.50 (leg 2 was about 0.61), so the pod may also read high. Keep pacing on boat-model power and GPS; if speed falls again at steady effort, clear again.

arguments.reason: Check leg 4 speed settled after rudder clear (leg 2 back was 3.15 m/s at boat 110 W); boat power on plan?

text: no cue: the rudder clear seems to have restored about 0.1 m/s at the same effort; speed still rising, check again in 110 s.

arguments.text: 20.8 min, 3740 m (2265 to go): paddler 9/10, starting to feel it but fine. Boat power 104 W (at about original CP 104), GPS 3.10 on back leg, boat reserve reads 42 pct but likely overstated (weed drag hid real effort 14-17.5 min). Share still 0.49: pod reads high. Effort trend 6,8,8,7,7,9. Decided: no push yet. Hold steady; at 1600 to go reassess with a fresh effort check; start the long build only from about 1000-1200 m, sprint from about 400 m.

text: no cue: paddler at 9/10 with 2.3 km left, so no push despite the boat model reserve; holding steady to reassess at 1600 m to go.

arguments.text: Lift now: steady build to the finish, long strong strokes.

arguments.reason: Check the build after the 5000 m turn: boat power above CP, no breather, effort
Call the final sprint (finish) at about 400 m to go

arguments.text: 6000 m out-and-back; current against on out legs (about -0.14), behind on back legs. Pod reads high since about 14 min (and weed was cleared at 17.5 min): pace on boat-model power (power_w, CP 108) and GPS. From 1730 m to go: steady build, boat power about 112-116 W (boat reserve 46 pct, maybe overstated). Last leg is a back leg (current behind). Call finish at about 400 m to go. Paddler effort 9/10 at 20.7 min, 7/10 at 23.7 min; takes breathers after turns onto out legs; push cue brings them back.

text: Cued push for a steady build over the last 1730 m: effort down to 7/10, boat power at CP with reserve left; finish call set for 430 m to go.

arguments.text: Breather done. Back on it now, build all the way home.

25.3 min, 4520 m (1480 to go): second breather started about 1475 s (boat 108 to 84 W, pod 214 to 169, share unchanged 0.50 so real, not weed). Paddler 8/10, Just a breather, I am fine. Cued push at about 45 s into it (first breather recovered on a push cue). If not back above 100 W boat within 60-80 s, treat as a real limit: no more pushes until the finish call.

arguments.reason: Did the push cue end the second breather (boat power back above about 105 W)?

text: Cued push: second voluntary breather with 1480 m to go (paddler says breather, fine; real effort drop, not drag); checking in 75 s.

arguments.text: 26.7 min, 4755 m (1245 to go): push cue at 25.3 did NOT end the slump: boat 87-88 W, pod 167-172 for 2.5 min (unlike first breather). Treat as a real limit (reserve truly empty; boat reserve 62 pct reading is wrong). No more push cues before the finish call; let them recover. Finish call at about 400 m (or 300 m if still below CP 100 W boat).

text: no cue: the push did not lift power this time, so this looks like a real limit; letting the paddler recover until the finish call.

arguments.text: Great power. Hold this through the turn, then bring it home.

27.8 min, 4950 m: paddler came back on their own after a 2.5 min slump: boat 115 W, pod 225. Cued hold through the 5000 m turn. Last leg is with the current. Finish call at about 430 m to go (wake set).

text: Cued hold through the last turn: paddler is back above CP after the slump; finish call set for about 430 m to go.

arguments.text: Last leg, current with you. Back to race pace now.
29.5 min, 5260 m (740 to go): third slump after the 5000 m turn (boat 80 W, pod 167). No new drag sign. Cued push to 160 s/500 ground (about CP with current behind). Finish call due at 430 m to go.

text: Cued push to 160 s/500 on the last leg: third slump with 740 m left; finish call due at 430 m.

arguments.text: Four hundred to go. Sprint now, everything to the line!

text: Called the final sprint at 429 m to go; power was already rising out of the slump.
no cue: 146 m left, the sprint is already called and the paddler has spent what they had; another cue cannot add speed.
